description: The last note of the bar raised. At 90 BPM, for four bars, the course project at this stage plays C3 on steps 1, 5 and 9 and D3 on step 13 of each bar, all at velocity 80 and half a step long. Listen for the bar's last note stepping up from C3 to D3 while the other three stay put.
